rows.whyBlockedSourceDespiteEverySourceBeingH: The stop is not a missing binary. All four declared digests resolve under the master library and were re-hashed from bytes by this lane. The stop is that the four held binaries are editions of DIFFERENT New Hampshire courts and cannot name one filing court between them.
rows.why: A packet is filed in one court. NHJB-3057-DSe, the petition, names its court through the drop-down court.district/su, whose 43 options are 11 Superior Courts and 31 Circuit Court District Divisions, so this route files in one of those two tiers. NHJB-2311-Se names its court through court.superior, whose 12 options are a blank and 11 Superior Courts and no Circuit Court division at all. NHJB-2328-DFPe names its court through court.district/family/probate - both, whose 74 options are District, Family and Probate divisions and include no Superior Court at all. In a Superior Court annulment the financial statement cannot name the court; in a District Division annulment the fee-waiver motion cannot. Neither form carries a free-text court field, so neither gap can be filled with text. The suffixes agree with the drop-downs: -Se is the Superior court edition, -DFPe the District, Family and Probate edition, -DSe the District edition of the petition. Filling the Superior motion for a Circuit Court annulment would deliver the wrong court's motion, and leaving its court blank would deliver a motion that does not say where it is filed. Neither is a defect a build can absorb.
rows.measuredByThisLaneIndependentlyOfTheBuil: Every drop-down and every field of all four binaries was enumerated directly from the master-library bytes with pdf-lib, not read back from the build script's own summary. The court-list measurement reproduced exactly.

additionalDefectThisLaneFoundAndTheScrip.finding: Its 43 options are Family Division and Probate Division entries exclusively. It reaches NEITHER tier this route files in, so unlike the two fee-waiver components - each of which can at least name a court in one tier - this component cannot name the filing court in any case this route can produce. It is blocked in every tier.
additionalDefectThisLaneFoundAndTheScrip.priorClaimCorrected: The build script previously returned componentsBuildable: [primary_filing, criminal_history_request] as a hardcoded literal. That named this component buildable and was wrong. This lane replaced both lists with a value computed from each binary's own chooser against the petition's own tiers, and added whichComponentsCanNameTheSameCourt, which resolves the question per tier rather than per component.

rows.purposeOfRecordLineIsAnOwnerDeterminatio: NHJB-2956 prints PURPOSE OF RECORD: Housing / Employment / Annulment/Expungement / Other ______. The route's identity answers it, but the binary draws no control beside the printed options - no AcroForm widget, no stroked box - so marking it would put ink at a hand-entered coordinate in white space, and writing the purpose into the Other rule would state that the purpose is Other, which is false. Not the stop; recorded for the owner.
whatWouldUnblockIt: binding the Circuit Court District Division fee-waiver motion that matches NHJB-3057-DSe and NHJB-2328-DFPe, rather than the Superior Court NHJB-2311-Se
or binding the Superior Court financial statement that matches NHJB-2311-Se and scoping this family to Superior Court annulments
and in either case binding a criminal-history release whose court chooser reaches the tier the packet is filed in, because NHJB-2956-FPe reaches neither
or an owner determination that the fee-waiver and criminal-history components may be dropped and replaced by a pointer to whichever forms the filing court actually uses
